title: The Mystery of the Blue Train
description: A murder mystery set across Europe involving the theft of priceless rubies and the murder of Viner Demetrius aboard the luxurious Blue Train. The detective Hercule Poirot (under the alias Flavelle Mason) must unravel the truth behind the crime, navigating a web of deceit, alibis, and hidden motives among the suspects.
intro_narrative: It was close on midnight when a man crossed the Place de la Concorde in Paris. A little man with a face like a rat, yet one who played a prominent part in the destiny of the world. This man, Ambrose Caux, had business to conduct—a transaction involving the legendary rubies known as the 'Heart of Fire.' Meanwhile, across Europe, a luxurious train known as the Blue Train carried passengers to the Riviera, among them Viner Demetrius, who harbored a secret rendezvous. By the time the train reached Nice, Viner Demetrius was dead, her face disfigured, and her priceless rubies stolen. The stage is set for a mystery that will unravel the darkest secrets of those aboard the Blue Train.
